When models use structured outputs with `strict=True` (e.g. OpenAI SDK via LangChain), Pydantic's strict type enforcement evaluates field-level types before field validators, throwing an error when encountering string values like `'None'`. Using a model validator safely coerces the payload before field type checks occur.
